description:
Implement bounded-distance decoding for nonbinary BCH codes against the canonical interfaces from epic ae03bcd0: constructions come from BchSpec / BchCode::construct over any FieldExtension base (crates/gf2-coding, per dev/active/ae03bcd0-general-bch/bch-api-design.md), and decoding reports the typed NoErrors/Corrected/Uncorrectable outcome contract with verified corrections, matching the binary decoder's guarantees (REQ-09 of ae03bcd0).

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Decoding operates over every supported base field of the canonical construction, using the field-generic traits::block surface, with typed outcomes and verified candidate corrections.
- [hard] REQ-02: The bounded-distance guarantee and beyond-radius behavior are documented, and shared property suites cover binary and nonbinary cases against reference decodings.
title: Generalized nonbinary BCH decoding against the canonical model
